summary: In the most recent reporting period, several incidents were documented at Boise State University, including cases of vandalism, domestic violence, and multiple alcohol-related violations. Notably, the frequency of alcohol violations remains high, particularly around Jade Hall, where multiple incidents were reported on the same night. Comparatively, incidents of domestic violence and DUI offenses have seen a slight uptick, with arrests made in several cases. Overall, while some violent crimes have been resolved swiftly through arrests, the persistence of alcohol-related offenses indicates an ongoing area of concern that warrants continued attention.
